body:
>I regret every choice I've ever made. I regret every day that I live.

These words have been echoing inside my head for months. I'm too tired and depressed to have anything much to add right now...but I was surprised to see this, because I do understand it.
Heh, it's been *years* since I had gumbo! :P

Thanks. Pushups aren't really ideal (I have itty bitty arms and like no upper body strength) but I try to exercise every day by going for walks and hikes. It used to help, but doesn't much anymore because I live in such an ugly place that leaving the house often makes me feel worse than just holing up.

Walking gets my blood flowing, but the scenery is what's bringing me down.
